messages:
paul: Quick sync for Atlas SI onboarding 1: marketplace listing + hardware voucher flow. Need final training dates and public playbook draft by next week. Who can own voucher redemption?
nora: I can take voucher redemption. Do we have a redemption API spec or do we build one?
ishaan: We have a small endpoint: POST /v1/partners/vouchers/redeem body {code,email}. I'll add a curl sample into the partner docs today.
rachel: I'll lead training content. Proposal: 2 workshops (deploy, reliability), 1 lab day. Proposed dates Jun 7, Jun 14, Jun 21. Need 2x A100 labs and 4 dev GPUs for pre-reqs. @ben can you reserve?
ben: Reserved 2 A100s for Jun 21 and 4 dev GPUs in partners pool. Send partner emails and tenant IDs to provision.
paul: Marketplace listing checklist: short blurb, logo, security attestation, 1 integration tutorial. Also want screenshot of routing UI and a quickstart YAML.
ishaan: Sample CLI to start a test model: ```
rwdctl run --model rwd/opt-6.7b --region eu-central --gpu a100
```
rachel: Certification idea: "Atlas Integrator" (hands-on) and "Atlas Architect" (deep ops). Exam: 30 Q + 2 labs, 75min. Badges: minted PNG + verify token. Telemetry for verification: partner_id, cert_id, pass_ts only.
nora: Legal ok with minimal telemetry. I'll get confirmation in thread. No end-customer PII.
paul: Need both a public-facing partner playbook PDF and an internal onboarding runbook. Target: draft by Wed, final by Fri COB.
ben: I'll create a shared Google Doc and export PDF. Draft by Tuesday evening.
rachel: Labs checkpoints: deploy -> smoke test -> load -> failover -> cost check. Each checkpoint will include a CLI acceptance test.
ishaan: Ops troubleshooting note: common issue is missing IAM role or KMS alias. Example: `aws kms create-alias --target-key-id <key-id> --alias-name alias/atlas-partner`
paul: Action items: Nora -> voucher flow + API sample; Rachael -> training syllabus + lab checks; Ben -> infra reservation + doc export; Ishaan -> CLI snippets + troubleshooting. I'll schedule a 20m sync Thu 8:30am PT and send invite.
nora: 👍
ben: on it :rocket:
rachel: thanks team :raised_hands:
